title: Link receipt freshness survives monotonic clock regression
description: LinkLayer receipt clock validates only finite nonnegative values and stores no nondecreasing high-water. If its exact MonotonicClock callback regresses after receipt issuance, purge compares against a lower now and otherwise-expired DIO/rekey/ACK evidence can remain elevatable. Bind a monotonic high-water to the Link/capability and permanently fail receipt issuance and elevation on regression, including concurrent reads. Add regression-before-consume/elevate and concurrent clock tests for every receipt consumer.
